issues.title: Range selector overlaps data visualization
issues.description: The time range filter buttons overlay and obscure the histogram bars in the lower section of the chart.
issues.evidence: The '1D 1H 1W 1M' button group sits directly over the vertical graph bars.
issues.suggestion: Position the range selector outside the histogram plotting area.
issues.triageNote: Real: root gap-2 left only 8px between the bottom-aligned h-12 bars (which touch the container's bottom edge) and the right-aligned 1D/1H/1W/1M pill row, so the pills read as sitting on the bars; increased root gap to gap-4 (16px).

issues.title: Redundant timestamp indicators
issues.description: The time range is duplicated within close proximity, adding minor visual noise over the waveform.
issues.evidence: Timestamps '13:12 - 20:24' appear both in the section header and inside the scrubber graph area.
issues.suggestion: Remove the floating chips or the header timestamp to streamline data presentation.
issues.triageNote: Real (partly composition): eval pages render the range in a header AND pass it to the tags; tags were already optional via rangeStart/rangeEnd, but the solid brand-primary chips (near-white blocks in dark theme) amplified the duplication into noise — restyled tags as quiet hairline panel chips and de-duplicated the demo header (eval headers are not editable).
